description: Small deterministic regression set for verdict-policy tests. Labels are test expectations, not a comprehensive benchmark; replace or expand with independently reviewed, sourced claims before reporting model accuracy.

examples.claim: A made-up claim with no evidence exists
examples.notes: No retrieved evidence must never become a confident true/false result.

examples.claim: The claim is contested by credible sources
examples.notes: Material support/refute disagreement requires abstention/contested result.

examples.claim: A claim backed by one publisher
examples.notes: One publisher is not independent consensus.

examples.claim: A claim supported by independent publishers
examples.notes: Only eligible when independent, relevant, direct evidence is present.

examples.claim: A claim refuted by independent publishers
examples.notes: Only eligible when independent, relevant, direct evidence is present.
